title: CAPTURE
description: Orchestrator → engine. Request a screenshot. The engine replies with binary frames (binary-frame-v1) carrying this message's id as request_id, or ERROR frame_too_large. With every_n_ticks it starts a live-view stream instead.

every_n_ticks.description: Start a live-view stream: the engine ACKs, then sends a live-view frame (frame_type 2) with this message's id as request_id whenever the game tick reaches a multiple of this value. The stream replaces any earlier one and ends with the session, surviving a resume. Needs supports.live_view.
